Verify real telephone microphone input, provider transcription, assistant response and RTP output separately from user hearing confirmation.
Enforce a per-call read-only scope at the backend: no approval decision, task dispatch, run control or memory tools.
Preserve pending approval identities and original task state.

phone local line settings without changing credentials

design.summary: Single-device local SIP/RTP bridge, localhost authenticated realtime relay, explicit server-side read-only call scope. No provider credentials on phone.

implementation.summary: Local register, outgoing/incoming calls, G.711, band-limited 24-to-8 kHz conversion, peak-limited playback gain and persistent idle mode. Read-only tool/executor/native-decision/dispatch guards; instruction refresh and bounded false-completion speech correction.
